purpose: Teach: 佞/膺/从/レイプ/横田/中原/田口/五郎

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、佞言、つまり佞の政治的虚言の歴史研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura — you wrote your paper on the history of rhetoric, didn't you? On 佞 — the political deception concept.
lines.style: Warm, attentive. Opening with genuine curiosity, not testing. Even pace, encouraging. The tone of a teacher who's read the work and wants to hear the student reflect on it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、膺懲、つまり膺の古い軍事用語の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on 膺懲 — the old military term. On what that character means historically.
lines.style: Direct, thoughtful. Steady delivery. Not performing modesty — just answering the question fully. Slight lift at the end, ready for the next one.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 漢字の从、つまり旧字の「従う」の字形研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you examined the character forms too, didn't you? The old-form 從 — how the shape itself changed over time.
lines.style: Gentle confirmation, like connecting threads. Slower pace, more reflective. Affirming the intellectual rigor without making a fuss of it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、性犯罪、つまりレイプ事案の刑法的研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I focused on sex crimes — rape cases specifically — from a criminal law perspective in my research.
lines.style: Clear, unflinching. No hedging. Steady eye contact in the voice. Matter-of-fact but not cold — the directness of someone who believes in her subject.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 横田基地周辺地域の社会学研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You also covered the sociology of the Yokota base region, if I remember.
lines.style: Reflective, confirming. Slightly softer attack. Checking in — respectful of the breadth of her interests. Curious about how the pieces fit together.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、中原中也、つまり詩人中原の文学研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote on Nakahara Chuya's poetry — the literary criticism of his work.
lines.style: Measured response. A note of care when she says the poet's name — respect for the subject. Even delivery, grounded. Not defensive, just precise.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 写真家田口氏のドキュメンタリー研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And the documentary work of photographer Taguchi — that was another focus of yours, wasn't it.
lines.style: Curious, connecting the dots. Warm but not effusive. The pace of someone genuinely impressed by the scope of work, reflecting it back gently.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、戦前の作家五郎氏の文学研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I examined the literary work of Goro, the prewar author. His contribution to that period.
lines.style: Confident close. Steady tone. The voice of someone who has done the work and can speak about it without apology. Clean finish, not trailing off.
